# Danish Civil Registration

This folder groups key administrative identifiers, clinical pathways, and reporting frameworks that support the Danish acute surgery database. It documents the national personal identification number used for patient tracking and data exclusion, the evidence-based postoperative recovery program that guides mobilization indicators, and the official guidelines for reporting data to the National Patient Register.

## Pages

- [[cpr-nummer|CPR-nummer]] — The Danish personal identification number, which serves as the primary key for patient tracking, record linkage, and exclusion filtering in the acute surgery database.
- [[eras|ERAS]] — The Enhanced Recovery After Surgery program, an evidence-based clinical pathway that informs national quality indicators for early postoperative patient mobilization.
- [[indberetningsvejledning-til-landspatientregisteret|Indberetningsvejledning til Landspatientregisteret]] — The official guidance document for correct data reporting to the Danish National Patient Register, ensuring the administrative accuracy required for cross-sectional clinical quality measurements.
